name: hit-the-ground-running
description: Hit The Ground Running: pushes the plan's 5-hour and weekly usage to the model, closes the agent-pool gate (no new subagents) near a limit but not on usage credits (switchable off per session, or suspended until the 5-hour reset with /htgr-gate, and suspended automatically when usage runs out), pauses running sessions at 90% of the 5-hour limit, and resumes the session after a cap resets, compacting first when the context is large, and, when workflowDir is set, loads that agent workflow into the model at every session start, clear, compaction and resume.

fiveHourResume.title: 5-hour cap resume
fiveHourResume.description: native: Claude's own auto-continue resumes 5-hour caps and the mod only compacts before it. mod: the mod resumes 5-hour caps itself; turn the native auto-continue off to avoid a double resume.

autoPause.title: Auto-pause at 5-hour usage
autoPause.description: When the 5-hour usage reaches this percentage, each session with a running turn does what /htgr-pause does: stops the turn and resumes after the 5-hour reset. Once per session per 5-hour period; off disables it.

weeklyResume.title: Weekly cap resume
weeklyResume.description: on: the mod resumes the session after a weekly cap resets. off: it does not.

workflowDir.title: Workflow directory
workflowDir.description: Absolute path of an Agent-Custom-Workflow checkout. When set, every session start, clear, compaction, resume or fork hands the model its CLAUDE.md (imports expanded) and workflows/AGENTS.root.md and tells it to read its intake owners (and the personality on the 'Personality:' line of ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md or the workflow's CLAUDE.md) before acting. Empty: off.
